units.source: I am Rowan, the ferryman. Our ferry crosses the Moonwater.
I am Rowan, the north gate guard. The gate closes at sunset. Halt. State your name. Show your papers.
The Moonwater divides the valley in two. The ferry crosses it.
A rumor says the old bell was destroyed years ago.
A rumor says the old bell is intact under the inn.
Maybe it happened there, but I do not know.

<|im_end|>
